Minor release focused on layout and navigation improvements in Municipio, safer webhook startup behavior, and more reliable cloned media imports. It introduces the new Negative Space module, improves hash-link behavior across the interface, and fixes several chat, menu, editor, and packaging issues.

## Municipio Deployment
- Fixed issue that the `object-cache.php` dropin was not up to date with the installed redis-cache plugin. We now copy the dropin from the installed plugin on `post-install-cmd`. 

## Municipio Theme [7.43.13...7.44.24](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.43.13...7.44.24)
- Negative Space Module: Adds a new Modularity module for creating negative-spacing layouts without custom code.
- Chat Block: Fixes the chat block cover state, CSS classes, interaction flow, and popover spacing so the block displays and behaves correctly.
- Menu Handling: Fixes clipping and background issues in menu modules, prevents submenu arrows from wrapping onto a new line, and makes `#` links toggle child menus more reliably.
- Gutenberg Compatibility: Ensures module assets and spacing styles load correctly in the block editor and updates block-style enqueueing for WordPress 7.2.
- Table of Contents: Removes unintended background styling from TOC elements for a cleaner appearance.
- Theme Packaging: Includes `theme.json` in distributed builds so packaged releases keep the expected theme configuration.

## Styleguide [3.32.5...3.33.5](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.32.5...3.33.5)
- Hash-link Navigation: Menu items that use `#` can now open and close their child menus directly from the main link, making navigation behave more predictably on click and touch.
- Pagination Controls: Previous and next buttons now use proper disabled states, preventing pagination controls from appearing clickable when no more pages are available.

## Municipio Clone [1.4.1...v1.4.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio-clone/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2)
- Media Import: Rewrites remote media URLs to the source site's actual media domain so cloned images and files keep working links.

## Webhooks Manager [1.3.2...1.3.3](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/webhooks-manager/compare/1.3.2...1.3.3)
- ACF Initialization: Defers loading ACF-backed webhook settings until ACF is ready, preventing fatal errors during early WordPress startup.

Minor release: This update focuses on navigation and interface improvements. Municipio adds a redesigned menu module with more flexible layouts, improved mobile chat behavior, and new button styling controls in the header and tab menus. Styleguide delivers a major popover refresh, a new site selector component, and more consistent color inheritance for navigation and buttons.

## Municipio Theme [7.38.6...7.43.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.38.6...7.43.1)
- Chat: Moves the chat script integration and adds a full-screen chat bubble layout for mobile devices.
- Language Menu: Fixes placement issues so the language switcher opens in the correct position.
- Menu Module: Introduces a clearer visual design with working expand and collapse behavior.
- Menu Module: Makes menu columns more fluid and adds a spaced layout option for better content balance.
- Header Buttons: Adds settings for controlling button styles in the header.
- Tab Menu: Adds support for button appearance settings in the tab menu alternative.
- Mega Menu: Keeps the mega menu label visible on mobile devices to avoid navigation issues.


## Styleguide [3.24.18...3.31.4](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.24.18...3.31.4)
- Popover: Reworks the popover component with a cleaner implementation, a new cover mode, and a smaller API.
- Popover: Improves positioning behavior by resetting calculations before placement and handling dropdown overflow more reliably.
- Site Selector: Adds a redesigned site selector component with updated sizing, spacing, and examples.
- Navigation Colors: Removes manual color overrides on basic navigation so it follows the surrounding design more consistently.
- Buttons: Lets buttons inherit the active color scheme, keeps button sizes aligned more consistently, and preserves corner shapes in SVG buttons.

## Deployment Configuration [7.38.6...7.43.1](https://github.com/municipio-se/municipio-deployment/compare/7.38.6...7.43.1)

- ACF Pro: Installs Advanced Custom Fields Pro as a must-use plugin so it loads before regular plugins.
- ACF Safety: Adds a must-use safeguard that throws a clear error if ACF fields are accessed too early.
- Municipio Clone: Adds the Municipio Clone plugin to the deployment.
- WordPress Core: Updates the Roots-managed no-content WordPress package from 7.1.1 to 7.1.2.
- WordPress Plugins: Updates Redirection to 5.10.1 and Redis Cache to 3.0.0.

This release updates the WordPress and WordPress plugin providers to Roots.io.

It also includes a minor fix to ensure that the correct configuration keys are used when enabling features in Like Posts, Event Manager Integration, and the Municipio theme's chat feature.

## [WordPress security updates](https://wordpress.org/documentation/wordpress-version/version-7-1-1/#security-updates)
This security and maintenance release features [17 bug fixes on Core](https://core.trac.wordpress.org/query?milestone=7.1.1&status=closed&group=status&order=priority), [21 bug fixes for the Block Editor](https://core.trac.wordpress.org/changeset/63587), and 11 security fixes. Because this is a security release, it is recommended that you update your sites immediately.

The security team would like to thank the following people for [responsibly reporting vulnerabilities](https://hackerone.com/wordpress?type=team), and allowing them to be fixed in this release:

- An issue allowing a crafted URL to install and preview a theme from WordPress.org reported by Paulos Yibelo and pwn.ai
- A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issue in custom header images on some themes reported by Jeremy Felt of the WordPress Security Team
- An information disclosure issue exposing the title of a private parent post reported by HDWSec
- An HTML API issue allowing modified text to break out of an HTML comment reported by Jeremy Felt of the WordPress Security Team
- A multisite issue allowing a site administrator to network-activate a network-only plugin reported by Jesse McNeil
- A Contributor+ arbitrary post overwrite issue reported by Anthropic
- An authenticated path traversal issue in the REST API templates controller reported by Anthropic
- An authorization issue allowing any authenticated user to reparent comments, including notes, reported by viridis
- An XML-RPC issue allowing changeset posts to bypass the custom CSS capability check reported by Ben Bidner of the WordPress Security Team
- A Contributor+ disclosure of draft and pending post slugs reported by hermanhms
- An unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issue via paragraph formatting, subject to comment approval, reported by Rafie Muhammad (Awesome Motive, Inc.)
Moves back acf pro to plugins folder

Improves navigation and popover-based interfaces across Municipio and Styleguide, strengthens image handling for transparent assets, and fixes a CSP filter regression in WPMU Security. Users can expect cleaner table-of-contents pages, more consistent menu and chat behavior, and better component documentation support.

## Municipio Theme [7.33.2...7.38.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/municipio/compare/7.33.2...7.38.2)
- Table of Contents: Fixes scroll offsets for floating or non-sticky headers and refreshes TOC page layouts for better readability.
- Table of Contents: Shows only one heading level by default, making long pages easier to scan.
- Language Menu: Rebuilds the language switcher as a popover and removes unnecessary markup attributes.
- Chat: Moves the chat interface to the shared popover pattern and correctly hides the bubble when the assistant is disabled.
- Images: Skips generated low-quality placeholders for transparent raster images and improves transparency detection for WebP files.
- Image Contracts: Fixes memory-size comparisons so image processing decisions are applied more reliably.
- Editor and Rendering: Corrects TinyMCE button behavior and restores closure handling in the renderer for custom integrations.

## Styleguide [3.19.10...3.24.0](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.19.10...3.24.0)
- Popover Component: Adds a reusable popover component with placement logic, optional backdrop support, and positioning relative to either the viewport or another element.
- Chat Layout: Resizes chat panels more sensibly on both large and small screens.
- Images: Adds mocked-image rendering options and new transparency examples for image components.
- Design Builder: Preserves numeric override values when saving settings.
- Accordion: Keeps focus and state rings visible inside paint-contained layouts.
- Documentation: Adds backward-compatible support for class-based component parameter declarations and improves PHP and JSON parameter parsing for component docs.
- Logotype: Fixes Safari logo positioning and corrects logotype masking placement.
- Component Targeting: Improves data-component targeting for JavaScript-initialized components.
- Component: Rebuild data contracts to php class based instructions. 

## WPMU Security [1.10.0...1.10.1](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.10.0...1.10.1)
- Content Security Policy: Returns the original markup after CSP inspection, fixing compatibility with markup filters that expect processed HTML to be passed through.

Minor release focused on UI refinements and compatibility updates. Styleguide adds async pagination, improved table behavior, and typography fixes, while WPMU Security removes exposed version metadata and the generator tag. The remaining package updates align internal dependencies with WpUtilService 0.3, preparing the platform for the broader dependency upgrade.

## Styleguide [3.18.2...3.19.10](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.18.2...3.19.10)
- Tables and Pagination: Adds async pagination, sorting, filtering, summary rows, and scroll indicators for richer table interactions.
- Typography and Layout: Reduces heading sizes in card content areas and prevents headings from dropping below date badges.
- Field Styling: Moves fieldset and legend styling to shared design tokens while preserving the existing visual appearance.

## Webhooks Manager [1.3.1...1.3.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/webhooks-manager/compare/1.3.1...1.3.2)
- Dependency Compatibility: Updates the internal WpUtilService dependency to `^0.3`, aligning the package with the platform's ongoing dependency upgrade.

## WP Page for Post Type [2.0.14...2.0.16](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wp-page-for-posttype/compare/2.0.14...2.0.16)
- Dependency Compatibility: Updates the internal WpUtilService dependency to `^0.3`, preparing the plugin for the shared dependency upgrade.

## WP Search Statistics [1.0.6...1.0.8](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/search-statistics/compare/1.0.6...1.0.8)
- Dependency Compatibility: Updates the internal WpUtilService dependency to `^0.3`, aligning the plugin with the new shared dependency baseline.
- Search Assets: Rebuilds the packaged search enhancer assets to match the updated dependency set.

## WPMU Security [1.9.2...1.10.0](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.9.2...1.10.0)
- Script Metadata: Hides version metadata from enqueued scripts to reduce exposed implementation details.
- Generator Tag: Removes the generator tag from output metadata for a cleaner and less revealing frontend footprint.

Patch release focused on stability, security, and admin consistency. It improves form validation under strict CSP, refines search-index settings behavior, fixes an interactive map filter issue, updates shared field styling, and lets trusted signed-in users bypass rate limits where appropriate.

## Modularity Form Builder [4.0.12...4.0.14](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-form-builder/compare/4.0.12...4.0.14)
- Honeypot Validation: Moves the timed honeypot check into the frontend bundle so form submissions continue to work under strict Content Security Policy settings.

## Municipio Theme [7.28.0...7.28.12](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.28.0...7.28.12)
- Search Index Settings: Ensures admin settings continue to respect values locked by configuration constants.
- Search Index: Enshure that all permalinks are indexed correctly. 
- Interactive Map: Closes open popups correctly when map filters are removed.

## Styleguide [3.18.2...3.18.4](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.18.2...3.18.4)
- Field Styling: Moves fieldset and legend styling to shared design tokens while preserving the existing appearance.

## WPMU Security [1.9.1...1.9.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/wpmu-security/compare/1.9.1...1.9.2)
- Rate Limiting: Lets trusted authenticated users bypass rate limiting to reduce unnecessary friction for known users.

Minor release focused on search, customizer polish, and runtime stability. Municipio now folds search indexing into the theme, improves indexed search results and layout, strengthens chat streaming and media handling, and reduces unnecessary rendering and query work across the site.

## Municipio Theme [7.21.0...7.28.0](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.21.0...7.28.0)
- Search Index: Builds search indexing into the theme, replacing the separate Algolia package setup. It integrates support for typesense and algolia providers while giving room to swiftly add additional providers. All search engines also support indexing files and module content. 
- Search Results: Adds schema.org data to indexed content, renders highlighted matches safely, and aligns the search page layout and filters more closely with the standard search experience.
- Search CLI: Removes the outdated `--provider` flag from the search index command and clarifies constant-based settings in the admin UI.
- Chat Streaming: Buffers server-sent events before forwarding them and removes unnecessary payload data sent to the browser.
- Customizer: Improves fallback handling, clearer labels and options, and a better header layout control layout while removing the drawer screen-size option.
- Media Handling: Stops retrying failed image conversions and validates image files earlier to avoid repeated processing errors.
- Performance: Cuts repeated work with block render caching, fewer duplicate queries, better cached module placement handling, and less unnecessary processing when TOC is disabled.
- Layout Fixes: Uses footer column settings correctly and avoids exposing the automatic post-language sentinel as an HTML language value.

Minor release focused on performance, chat stability, and a small guide visibility fix. Municipio reduces repeated rendering and trims chat traffic, Styleguide brings component-level performance improvements, and Modularity Guides fixes display issues in guide content.

## Modularity Guides [5.0.12...5.0.14](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/modularity-guides/compare/5.0.12...5.0.14)
- Guide Visibility: Fixes visibility issues in guide content so items display more reliably.

## Municipio Theme [7.17.2...7.20.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/Municipio/compare/7.17.2...7.20.2)
- Chat Streaming: Buffers streamed chat events before sending them onward, preventing broken partial responses.
- Chat Payloads: Removes unnecessary data from chat responses sent to the browser.
- Rendering Performance: Reduces repeated work across the theme, including faster S3 usage checks, cached image focus handling, and runtime caching to avoid rendering blocks multiple times.
- Table of Contents: Skips TOC parsing when the feature is turned off, avoiding unnecessary processing.
- Footer Layout: Uses footer column settings correctly and falls back to three columns when no value is set.
- Register openstreetmap as allowed CSP sources. 

## Styleguide [3.18.0...3.18.2](https://github.com/helsingborg-stad/styleguide/compare/3.18.0...3.18.2)
- Component Performance: Brings updated Component Library internals that improve classname resolution, warmup behavior, controller reuse, and image focus handling.
